name: ANSI/IEEE Microphone input form
summary: IEEE-library form of microphone input: a microphone indication identifies an acoustic-input transducer in a communications circuit.
description: This reference locates microphone input in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented annunciations family. A microphone indication identifies an acoustic-input transducer in a communications circuit. The public library uses HAN1B9 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
